LVEF not documented – assumed HFpEF; confirm with echocardiogram to ensure appropriateness of beta‑blocker and SGLT2‑inhibitor dosing.
Urate level not available – gout management deferred until urate measured.

treatment_summary: The plan upgrades secondary prevention (high‑intensity atorvastatin, low‑dose aspirin) and optimises antihypertensive therapy (add bisoprolol, consider amlodipine if BP remains high) while introducing dapagliflozin for HFpEF/CKD protection. Existing ACE‑I and thiazide are continued. Interactions are manageable with monitoring, and no contraindicated agents are added. Key labs (eGFR, K+, LFTs, lipids, echocardiogram) are required before finalising doses.
